median_age_note: Interpolated within the five-year age group holding the middle person, from Table 6's 2022 counts by district.
sex_ratio_note: Males per 1,000 females in OCHA's COD-PS for this country, reference year 2010, built from the country's official population figures; for a year after the last census, a projection.
population_note: SIB's weighted 2022 census count for the district (Table 5).
ethnicity_note: The 2022 census's ethnicity question, everyone counted (Table 8). SIB's figures are weighted and rounded here to whole people.
religion_note: The 2022 census's religion question, everyone counted (Table 9), SIB's own categories; "None" is written as No religion.
language_basis: languages spoken, more than one per person; share of the whole population
language_note: Languages spoken, asked of everyone aged four and over, who could name several (Table 7). Each share is the part of the district's whole population that speaks the language, so the shares sum to more than 100; children under four are in the base and were not asked, and people who cannot speak are not shown.
